full_judgment: 19. Moreover, we find that in execution case No. 2 of 1989 the proclamation was issued for sale of 0.05 1/3 acre of land of SA plot No. 2334 appertaining to SA Khatian No. 821 and CS Khatian No. 821 and in execution case No. 3 of 1989, in addition to said land, another land measuring 10 decimals out of 43 decimals of plot No. 2555 appertaining to Khatian No. 330 for recover of Taka 1,50,000 in each execution. Land of plot No. 2555, it is submitted by Mr Afzalur Rahman for the petitioner, was never attached. On the other hand, the order attaching the land of plot No. 1334 shows that there are godown, shop and house situate on the land. The proclamation does neither contain full particulars of the nature of property nor the probable market price of the property. The law is settled that in the absence of such particulars, no valid order for proclamation for sale could be made.
